title: Tree
body:
Description

The Tree takes the appearance of a classic Roblox tree, with a single sphere as the leaves and a long rectangle for the trunk. The Tree appears within the Classic Biome.

Trivia

  • The Tree first appeared for a total of 48 hours in celebration of the game hitting 1 million visits on January 21st, 2023.
  • These trees are a reference to trees that were from old Roblox games, such as Happy Home of Robloxia.
  • Its predecessor is the "Pink Tree" from Woodmill inc. It was a tree that spawned in all of the servers upon reaching a large milestone. Internally, it was named "Plastic", and had the default Roblox plastic material applied on it's plank form.
  • Due to a miscalculation, this tree was removed two hours early, but was brought back for an extended period to compensate the lost hours.
  • It was originally obtainable for a limited amount of time after the game reached a certain visit milestone, alongside the Ore, but now spawns all year round in the Classic Biome.
